name: obsidian-explorer-order-editor
description: Drag folders and notes into a manual order, in the file explorer itself or in a dialog. Stored as plain text inside your vault.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && tsc -p test --noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
